fixture: Only g18 seeds the wallet to zero, after the actual prepaid and paid rests. All choices, rests and the lesson use the real controls. g17 is the first no-credit rest, on day 3 after the preceding prepaid rest; line 6 has no clock UI. For g30 this shorter run places the player at the market scales, then uses the actual lesson buttons. The full native run previously verified the physical route.
method: Native Godot viewport. Local mouse clicks dispatch through the production hit regions and buttons.

g03_arrival__quay_reply__build.png.arrival_reply: Porters, sacks, goats. Nobody looks at you twice - except at your clothes.

g05_arrival__fair_changer__build.png.arrival_reply: He weighs every coin in front of you and counts two hundred local coins into your hand.

g06_arrival__smiling_changer__build.png.arrival_reply: He counts fast and presses coins into your hand. One hundred and twenty. You cannot tell if that is right.

g17_market_map__morning_after_rest__buil.toast: You pay 2 coins and sleep. Morning comes.

g18_market_map__rest_cannot_pay__build.p.toast: You cannot pay, so you sweep the stable for a straw bed. Morning comes.

g30_after_lesson__cheat_found__build.png.toast: Now you can read a scale - and you realise the smiling money-changer gave you 120 coins for silver worth 200.
